reviews.title: Bang for your buck
reviews.comment:
Nice air cooler!
Easy to install and mount on your motherboard.
Good price to value ratio.
I am satisfied with the size and quality of the cooler.
The design is nice and simple. I like the ascent design.
I have two of these in separate PC towers and they have kept my rigs cool.
reviews.author: RJ

reviews.title: Amazing Temps
reviews.comment: A really good cooler that cools my LGA 1700 13700k phenomenally despite it being an air tower. Works great and installation is really straight forward, nothing out of the ordinary here. Outperformed my previous thermal right peerless assassin by about 4 degrees Celsius, but this one looks much better in the case. Fits in my dan a3 case by Lian li even with moving the front fan up a bit for RAM clearance. Would highly recommend this case. Great value for money and gives thermal right a run for its money.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: its the one thing keeping my computer from going nuclear
reviews.comment:
bought this for my computer, it wasn't terribly overheating but i needed an upgrade from the stealth cooler i bought when i first built the computer so i bought this thing, money well spent it turns out. it's got a bit of noise but my case fans drown out what little noise this gives off boy at full blast it's got a bit of a deep hum to it, which is pretty good sounds.
the installation was easy, it's not toddler level intuitive, you might have to read the manual but if you know what you are doing, it's a pretty easy install, even with tall ram, just move one of the fans around. you'll find a good fit if you have tall ram if you experiment a little.
after installing, my cpu was... well it would still burn me but in cpu world, it's a lil chilly. my cpu overheated a lot less now, it overheated so little i was able to sneak in a little overclocking on the side and squeeze more performance out. overall a great upgrade for a computer starting out with a stealth cooler if you want a performance boost on the side too. if not, it might keep your cpu cool enough to extend it's life a good amount.
reviews.author: M1SSINGNOwO

reviews.title: Aesthetically Pleasing with Great Performance
reviews.comment:
As soon as I seen the looks of this cooler, I knew it was the one I have been looking for. Upon opening the box, however, I was immediately worried about the quality. The fins feel really fragile, and the black coating can easily be scratched if you are not careful, which could instantly ruin some of the looks you are paying the extra $10 for (It is $30 for the original one and $40 for this one). The fin covers where it has the design and 'FROZN' logo is also extremely cheap feeling as it is thin plastic.
The cooler was pretty easy to install. Despite the feelings of cheap materials, this cooler is extremely slick to look at. If you want a 'Blacked Out' build, I recommend this cooler. I am thinking about dropping it into a white case just to make my hardware "pop" even more.
The performance is also actually really great too. I'm only using this on a 5600x, but it dropped my gaming temps from around 84c down to 62c. I was only using a Wraith Prism before I bought this cooler, and I am overall satisfied.
The fans that came with this cooler feel solid overall and stay relatively quiet until higher temps, but I can't hear it over my headset while gaming. No reverb or bad bearings as of yet.
$40 feels a little much for how cheap some of it feels, but it only feels cheap and doesn't look cheap. I suppose since the performance is great it is worth that price as it is a competitive price with similarly designed dual tower coolers.
(In case it could be important and if anyone is wondering, I am using a 5600x paired with a RX 6700 XT at 1440p. Around 100 frames in demanding games. My PC case doesn't have the best airflow either so performance might vary for you if you bought this cooler. I would recommend it.)
